title: The Journey Begins.
transcript: I recently played in a chess tournament, but I suffered loss after loss after loss, and I was really disappointed with myself. That day, I got back home and I didn't want to think about chess anymore. I thought that I was done with it. But then I realized that the Amsterdam Open was going to be just one month away. And let me tell you something about myself. I'm not a quitter. So, I've decided that I am going to participate in the tournament and I plan to win it. I got in touch with my coach, Lawrence Strength, and I told him my goal. >> All right, Petro, we've got some serious work to do. Let's get to business. >> Over the next month, I am going to study chess every chance I get. But not only that, I'm going to eat healthy, work out because a sharp mind lives in a healthy body. I'm going to meditate to control my emotions. And of course, I'm going to keep making videos as well as keep teaching chess because, well, I need to eat. [Music]
